jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst
jobs.description:
1. About Our Client:
The organization operates within the in-home care sector, addressing a significant need among older adults and their families for accessible, affordable, and quality in-home care providers. It focuses on enabling older adults to review, select, and access care services efficiently. The program''s mission centers on extending the time people can remain in their homes through data-driven services that improve experiences for both payers and care recipients.

2. About the Opportunity:
The Senior Data Analyst role is responsible for leading analytics and reporting for a specific business line, initially focusing on Long-Term Care Insurance products. This position ensures accurate and timely delivery of partner reports and invoices, modernizes reporting infrastructure using current data tools, and provides actionable analysis to support business decisions. The role directly impacts operational and product strategies by moving beyond descriptive reporting to predictive and prescriptive insights.

3. Responsibilities:
• Manage recurring invoices and partner reporting for assigned business line with accuracy and punctuality.
• Rebuild and maintain reporting workflows using dbt to create tested and version-controlled data models.
• Develop and sustain internal data products such as dashboards and automated reports, retiring legacy reports as appropriate.
• Write and maintain clean SQL queries against BigQuery and manage code through Git workflows.
• Oversee scheduled data pipelines to ensure automated reporting with exception alerts.
• Maintain comprehensive understanding of data flow from source systems to final reports to identify and resolve discrepancies.
• Reconcile migrated reporting outputs to ensure consistency before decommissioning old systems.
• Understand partner contracts and billing terms thoroughly to interpret data accurately.
• Collaborate directly with business and operations leaders to align analytics with priorities and operational realities.
• Advance analytics capabilities towards predictive and prescriptive analyses that influence decision-making.
• Utilize AI tools to enhance productivity and share effective methods with the team.
• Prepare documentation to enable uninterrupted reporting during absences.
• Identify and address errors or unclear logic proactively, raising concerns early.
• Perform additional duties as needed to support team and organizational goals.

4. Requirements:
• Experience managing recurring business reporting and invoicing with high accuracy.
• Proficiency with dbt for developing tested and version-controlled data models.
• Strong skills in writing and testing SQL queries in BigQuery.
• Familiarity with Git and code review workflows.
• Experience with scheduling and monitoring data pipelines (e.g., Airflow).
• Ability to trace data lineage from source to report and troubleshoot discrepancies.
• Knowledge of billing contracts and terms relevant to assigned business line.
• Capability to work independently with a focus on data accuracy and timeliness.
• Experience partnering directly with business and operations leaders.
• Aptitude for progressing analytics maturity towards predictive and prescriptive insights.
• Competence in leveraging AI tools to increase efficiency.

5. Pay Range and Compensation Package:
• The pay range and compensation package for this role will be determined based on the candidate’s experience, skills, and other relevant factors.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or national origin.

jobs.title: Sr. BI Data Analyst
jobs.description:
1. About Our Client:
This organization operates in the healthcare technology sector, focusing on physician enablement. It collaborates with medical groups, health plans, and health systems to optimize physician practices and improve patient experiences. The organization uses scalable operations and cloud-based technology to reduce healthcare costs, enhance outcomes, and support provider well-being.

2. About the Opportunity:
The Sr. BI Data Analyst on the Medical Economics team plays a crucial role in delivering high-value analysis and reports that inform strategic decisions. This position involves independent collaboration with cross-functional teams to interpret business needs and develop analytical solutions that support both internal operations and payer relationships.

3. Responsibilities:
• Support market-level incentive payment distribution, including calculating and coordinating bonus distributions with relevant leadership and finance teams.
• Manage and maintain performance evaluations, reporting, and executive-level analyses for Value-Based Contracts.
• Translate business requirements into technical specifications and create scalable analytical solutions using structured and unstructured data.
• Partner with Data Engineering and Product teams to ensure data availability, address data quality issues through SQL queries, and implement data validation processes.
• Gather user feedback to align reporting tools with business needs and develop new reporting tools and ad hoc analyses.
• Collaborate independently across teams to advise on strategic decision-making and improve operational performance.
• Identify opportunities to enhance data products and reporting based on industry, regulatory, and technical trends.
• Perform other duties as assigned.

4. Requirements:
• Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field or equivalent experience, preferably in healthcare.
• Minimum 4 years’ experience in analytics, business intelligence, finance, or related quantitative roles with project leadership.
• High proficiency in SQL with capability to write optimized queries for large datasets.
• Strong verbal and written communication skills, including experience managing executive-level stakeholders.
• Hands-on experience with data modeling; familiarity with version control systems and code deployment preferred.
• Preferred experience in healthcare analytics involving claims, EMR, or lab data.
• Experience with Python for analysis and reporting.

5. Pay Range and Compensation Package:
• The salary range for this role is $81,000 to $95,000 base pay, excluding bonuses and benefits.
• Eligible for an annual bonus targeted at 15%.
• Base pay is determined based on experience, education, and geographic location.

6. Benefits & Perks:
• Medical insurance
• Dental insurance
• Vision insurance
• 401(k)
• Paid time off
• Other wellness programs
